test_title: PYST 8: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pillows are mats.

Some mats are cushions.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some pillows are cushions.

(II): All cushions are mats.
solution:
Statement 1: Some pillows are mats

Statement 2: Some mats are cushions

**Syllogism rule (Some + Some → No definite conclusion)**

From Statement 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7ed9d9e6ec328c9210a0179894747adc17118a3ff8f93b7cdeb82168359f80b.png] 

Check Conclusion I:

Some pillows are cushions

⇒ Not definite (pillows part of mats may be different from mats part of cushions) ✖

Check Conclusion II:

All cushions are mats

⇒ Given only "Some mats are cushions"

⇒ Cannot conclude "All cushions are mats" ✖

**∴ Neither conclusion I nor II follows.**

3b:T
